slides.text: some friends feel like [[the long walk home]] after school. even when the streetlights came on, we never took the shortcut.

caption:
remember when we used to drag our feet past the corner shop just to stretch out the afternoon?
we had absolutely nothing to say, and we said it for hours.
send this to the school friend who used to carry half your books.
